position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Port Said at (31.26, 32.3), in the Moustafa Hamza neighbourhood by Port Said railway station, about 570 m north of the container terminal and on land.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 300 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it (the sea within its coastline, rivers, docks and basins), with the terminals kept whole
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Port Said. These are the hull of West Port Said Container Terminal grown by 300 m, cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it, with the terminal kept whole: the terminal and the water in front of it, which takes in a stretch of the canal's channel through Port Said harbour, not the Port Said streets behind or the Ismail, Hussein and Salt basins further east. A scan of OpenStreetMap finds no homes, residential land, schools, hospitals, places of worship or named places inside. OpenStreetMap maps Al Da'era Al Gomrokia, the customs district, as a neighbourhood outline that covers all of the limits.

properties.name: West Port Said Container Terminal
properties.operator: Port Said Container & Cargo Handling Co.
properties.note: The container terminal on the west side of the harbour, mapped as a container terminal (man_made=container_terminal) named West Port Said Container Terminal in OpenStreetMap. OpenStreetMap's Port Said West port area (relation 14374024) covers the same quays and is left out as a duplicate. The public-sector Port Said Container & Cargo Handling Co. runs it, as Lloyd's List and the company's own posts say.
